_comment: THE REPOSITORY ROOT's declaration: what this instance IS and which directories it holds. Its sibling `ihris.config.json` says how it is configured. Written following folio-assistant's cat-harness/docs/bootstrap/initialization.md: declaration first, then only the directories it names.
name: ihris
title: iHRIS Knowledge Base
description: A folio-assistant folio that ingests and DESCRIBES the knowledge assets of iHRIS, the open-source health workforce information system: Launchpad source (by `lp:` reference, never copied), iHRIS 5 on GitHub (pinned by commit), the Implementation Toolkit, the old wiki, and documents people share. It is the umbrella over one instance per core source repository and one per knowledge source.
_instances_comment: One instance per core Launchpad repository, per the owner's ruling on issue #1 ('instance for each lp repo'), plus iHRIS 5, the toolkit and the wiki. Core = i2ce, ihris-common, ihris-manage, ihris-qualify, ihris-plan, openhie-pr. The other 31 Launchpad projects (country customizations and side tools) are described in the root catalogue at src/catalogue/ only. ihris-4-on-fhir (2026-09-23) is derived content, and the only subgraph that depends on smart-base.

directories.description: The ingestion queue: raw captures exactly as received (Launchpad pages, toolkit pages, GitHub inventories, source-tarball manifests). NOT corpus. Tarballs are git-ignored; their manifests pin them by checksum.

directories.readOnlyBasis: Generated by src/tools/build_kg.py from uploads/launchpad/. Edit the capture or the script, never the node.
directories.description: The iHRIS Suite project group on Launchpad and every project in it (plus openhie-pr, openhie, openinfoman), each as a folio-catalogue-node/v1 by reference with an ihris-source-record/v1 companion. Core projects point at their own instance.
The four schemas this folio adds (ihris-source-record, ihris-i2ce-module, ihris-form-class, ihris-toolkit-stage). Everything else reuses folio-assistant's own.
The procedures used to build this graph, as skills an agent can repeat.
The scripts that regenerate every derived node, with a Tool node (*.tool.json) for each.
Reader-facing documentation about this knowledge base. docs/generated/ is build output.
Adopted methodologies (folio-methodology/v1), one directory each. wiregen is drafted here provisionally; by methodology-adoption §4 it belongs in the harness (bean ihris-0nml).

BPMN processes GENERATED from processes/specs/*.json by src/tools/gen_bpmn.py. Judgement points call folio-assistant's existing processes (Process_Adjudication, Process_OptionsAnalysis, Process_Ingestion) instead of copying them.
Referenced source documents (reference only when the source states no licence): headings, page ranges and a summary in our own words.
